files.role: FastAPI application entry point. Initialises logging, Postgres pool, FCM credential, APScheduler, and installs platform_errorhandling middleware. Registers startup and shutdown lifecycle events.
Postgres connection pool management. Follows the same pattern as WorkoutTracker/backend/database.py and TaskTracker/backend/database.py.

methods.name: init_pool
methods.purpose: Initialise the module-level psycopg2 connection pool from DATABASE_URL env var. Called once on FastAPI startup.

methods.name: get_db
methods.purpose: Context manager that yields a connection from the pool and returns it on exit. Used by service and dispatch job.

files.role: Pydantic request and response models for the notification API. NotificationRecord is the shared view produced by this component.

methods.name: model fields
methods.purpose: Validated incoming fields for creating a notification. deep_link must begin with atlas://. fcm_token is accepted but never returned in responses.

methods.name: model fields
methods.purpose: API response shape for a notification. Excludes fcm_token — must never be present in this model.

files.role: Business-free notification lifecycle operations: create, cancel, replace. Called by router and by the dispatch job indirectly. All database access goes through database.get_db.

methods.name: create
methods.purpose: Generate a UUID, write a pending notification row to Postgres, return NotificationRecord (without fcm_token).

methods.name: cancel
methods.purpose: Set status=cancelled if status=pending. No-op if status=dispatched. Raise NotificationNotFoundError if id does not exist.

methods.name: replace
methods.purpose: Call cancel(old_id) then create(new_payload). Not atomic. Propagates errors from cancel before attempting create.

files.role: APScheduler job that polls Postgres for due pending notifications and dispatches them through FCM. Called every 5 seconds by the BackgroundScheduler registered in main.py.

methods.name: dispatch_due_notifications
methods.purpose: Query pending notifications with fire_at <= now(). For each: build FCM data-only message, call firebase_admin.messaging.send(), record dispatched_at, compute delta_ms, log at INFO (notification_id, fire_at, dispatched_at, delta_ms — never fcm_token), update status=dispatched. On FCM error: update status=failed, log at ERROR.

files.role: FastAPI router for notification lifecycle HTTP endpoints. Calls NotificationService. Returns NotificationRecord or api_error responses.

methods.name: create_notification
methods.purpose: POST /api/notifications/ — persist notification, return record with status=pending. HTTP 201 on success.

methods.name: cancel_notification
methods.purpose: DELETE /api/notifications/{notification_id} — cancel pending record or no-op on dispatched. Returns api_error NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND on missing id.

methods.name: replace_notification
methods.purpose: POST /api/notifications/{notification_id}/replace — cancel old, create new. Returns new NotificationRecord. HTTP 201 on success.

files.role: FCM credential loading and firebase_admin initialisation. Isolates credential management from dispatch logic. Called once during FastAPI startup.

methods.name: init_fcm
methods.purpose: Load FCM service account credential from FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_PATH (file path) or FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_CONTENT (raw JSON string). Initialise firebase_admin app. Raise RuntimeError if neither env var is set.

methods.name: send_fcm_message
methods.purpose: Build a data-only FCM message and call firebase_admin.messaging.send(). Return the FCM message ID string on success. Raise on FCM error — caller is responsible for catching and setting status=failed.

files.role: APScheduler BackgroundScheduler lifecycle management. Isolates scheduler wiring from main.py for testability.

methods.name: start_scheduler
methods.purpose: Create a BackgroundScheduler with memory job store, register dispatch_due_notifications with IntervalTrigger(seconds=5), start the scheduler, and return it.

methods.name: stop_scheduler
methods.purpose: Stop the scheduler cleanly. Called on FastAPI shutdown.

files.role: Unit tests for NotificationService (create, cancel, replace) and dispatch_due_notifications. Test scenarios enumerated in architecture.json deferrals.test_writer.
Integration tests for the HTTP endpoints using FastAPI TestClient. Covers request validation, response shapes, and error responses.
Postgres schema for the notifications platform. Creates the notifications schema and notification table. Implementer populates from architecture.json persistence.schema_notes.
Python package definition and dependency declaration. Must include fastapi, uvicorn, psycopg2-binary, pydantic, APScheduler>=3.0<4.0, firebase-admin.
